outlooks.summary: SCATTERED STORMS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL...AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO WILL BE POSSIBLE FROM THE OHIO VALLEY EASTWARD ACROSS THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION THURSDAY...PARTICULARLY ACROSS THE MID OHIO VALLEY AND INTO WEST VIRGINIA. RISK FOR ISOLATED HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS IS ALSO APPARENT OVER PORTIONS OF THE EASTERN COLORADO VICINITY...WITH A MORE ISOLATED RISK FOR HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS POSSIBLE OVER THE REMAINDER OF THE HIGH PLAINS -- FROM EASTERN MONTANA TO EASTERN NEW MEXICO -- AND EASTWARD ACROSS KANSAS AND INTO THE OZARKS.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: WHILE W-E RIDGING PERSISTS ACROSS THE SRN HALF OF THE CONUS...SLIGHT AMPLIFICATION OF THE FLOW FIELD ACROSS THE NRN HALF OF THE U.S. IS EXPECTED THIS PERIOD...AS AN UPPER LOW MOVES GRADUALLY INTO THE PAC NW...AND THE TROUGH OVER THE NORTHEAST U.S. EXPANDS SLIGHTLY. AT THE SURFACE...A COLD FRONT IS FORECAST TO SHIFT ACROSS THE NWRN U.S. WHILE A LEE TROUGH LINGERS ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS. FARTHER E...A CONVECTIVELY REINFORCED SURFACE BOUNDARY WILL SAG SWD ACROSS THE OH VALLEY VICINITY...AND SEWD ACROSS THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION THROUGH THE PERIOD.

sections.title: THE OH VALLEY AREA EWD INTO THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION AND NRN NC
sections.text: WIDESPREAD STORMS OVER THE IL/IN/OH VICINITY EARLY THIS MORNING WILL CONTINUE SHIFTING ESEWD THROUGH THE MORNING ACROSS THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS INTO VA AND VICINITY. QUESTIONS EXIST AS TO WHETHER THE STORMS WILL BE ABLE TO MAINTAIN SOME INTENSITY AS THEY CROSS THE TERRAIN OR PERHAPS REDEVELOP E OF THE TERRAIN DURING THE FIRST FEW HOURS OF THE PERIOD...OR WHETHER THE CONVECTION REMAINS LARGELY SUB-SEVERE AS IT SHIFTS OFFSHORE. ATTM...IT APPEARS THAT AT LEAST LIMITED WIND/HAIL RISK WILL EXIST WITH STORMS EITHER SURVIVING -- OR REDEVELOPING -- AS THEY CROSS THE HIGHER TERRAIN...AND THUS WILL MAINTAIN SLIGHT RISK ACROSS THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION AND EXTENDING SWD INTO NRN NC. FARTHER TO THE WNW...REMNANT OUTFLOW SHOULD RESIDE ACROSS THE INDIANA/SRN OH/WV VICINITY INTO THE AFTERNOON...WITH HEATING/MODERATE DESTABILIZATION EXPECTED INVOF THIS BOUNDARY. AS WEAK SHORT-WAVE TROUGHING WITHIN THE ENHANCED WNWLY FLOW FIELD ALOFT SHIFTS ACROSS THE MIDWEST...REDEVELOPMENT OF STORMS INVOF THE OUTFLOW WILL LIKELY OCCUR. GIVEN THE LIKELIHOOD FOR A FAVORABLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS AND THE PRESENCE OF 40-50 WNWLYS ALOFT...RISK FOR ORGANIZED STORMS -- AND POSSIBLE DEVELOPMENT OF ANOTHER SEWD-MOVING MCS -- IS

sections.title: CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS AND VICINITY
sections.text: STORMS ONGOING ACROSS THE SRN PLAINS REGION OVERNIGHT SHOULD DIMINISH/SHIFT SLOWLY EWD DURING THE MORNING HOURS...POSSIBLY LINGERING INTO SWRN KS/NRN OK. IN THE WAKE OF THIS EARLIER CONVECTION...HEATING ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS SHOULD RESULT IN ISOLATED STORM DEVELOPMENT DURING THE MID TO LATE AFTERNOON...AIDED BY SEVERAL SUBTLE VORTICITY MAXIMA PROGGED TO SHIFT ENEWD ACROSS THE REGION. WHILE FLOW ALOFT SHOULD REMAIN RELATIVELY WEAK ACROSS THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS /H5 FLOW WLY AOA 20 KT/...LOW-LEVEL SELYS SHOULD HELP PROVIDE AMPLE SHEAR FOR A FEW ORGANIZED CELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LOCALLY GUSTY WINDS AND HAIL. FARTHER N...MORE FAVORABLE SHEAR PROFILES ARE EXPECTED...WITH STRONGER SELYS BENEATH MID-LEVEL WLYS IN EXCESS OF 40 KT OVER ERN MT. HOWEVER...WEAKLY RISING HEIGHTS THROUGH THE DAY AHEAD OF THE UPPER LOW SHIFTING INTO THE PAC NW SHOULD LIMIT STORM COVERAGE. ANY STORM WHICH DOES DEVELOP HOWEVER WOULD LIKELY BECOME SUPERCELLULAR...WITH LARGE HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS POSSIBLE -- AND EVEN AN TORNADO IS NOT OUT OF THE QUESTION -- FROM LATE AFTERNOON INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS. ..GOSS/COOK.. 06/23/2016

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WINDS...LARGE HAIL...AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO OR TWO...ARE EXPECTED TODAY INTO EARLY TONIGHT FROM PARTS OF THE OHIO VALLEY INTO THE SOUTHERN MID ATLANTIC. A MORE ISOLATED WIND AND HAIL RISK WILL EXTEND WEST TO SOUTHERN KANSAS AND THE CENTRAL/NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: OH VALLEY TO MID ATLANTIC THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: ONGOING CLUSTERS OF THUNDERSTORMS WILL MOVE ESEWD OVER WV AND VA THE FIRST PART OF TODAY AND WEAKEN SLOWLY. ISOLATED STRONG/SEVERE STORMS WITH DAMAGING GUSTS AND HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE ALONG THE SRN FRINGE OF THE ONGOING CLUSTERS FROM SRN WV INTO CENTRAL/SRN VA...WHERE NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT IS MORE PROBABLE DURING THE DAY. THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY TRAILING FROM THE MORNING CONVECTION WILL STALL OR RETREAT NEWD SOME THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS WV/NRN KY/SRN OH...AS A WEAK SURFACE LOW MOVES ESEWD ALONG THE BOUNDARY IN ADVANCE OF A MIDLEVEL TROUGH NOW OVER WI/LOWER MI. THE GLANCING INFLUENCE OF THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND DAYTIME HEATING/MIXING WILL SUPPORT ADDITIONAL THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON ALONG THE REMNANT OUTFLOW ACROSS SRN OH/NRN KY/WV. THE STRONGER MID-UPPER FLOW AND RESULTANT DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL EXTEND AS FAR S AS THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...WHICH WILL SUPPORT A RISK FOR ORGANIZED STORM CLUSTERS AND POTENTIALLY SOME SUPERCELLS ALONG THE NE EDGE OF THE STRONGER BUOYANCY. A TORNADO OR TWO WILL BE POSSIBLE WHERE STORMS INTERACT WITH ANY LINGERING ENHANCEMENT TO LOW-LEVEL SHEAR ALONG THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. HOWEVER...DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE TH

sections.title: CENTRAL/NRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: LOW-LEVEL WINDS WILL BECOME SELY ACROSS THE CENTRAL/NRN HIGH PLAINS TODAY IN RESPONSE TO CYCLOGENESIS IN THE LEE OF THE NRN ROCKIES...DOWNSTREAM FROM A STRONG MIDLEVEL TROUGH OVER THE PAC NW. BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS WILL LIKELY REMAIN IN THE 50S ACROSS THE PLAINS OF ERN CO...WITH LESSER MOISTURE WITH NWWD EXTENT INTO MT...THOUGH VERTICAL SHEAR WILL TEND TO INCREASE TOWARD MT. DIURNAL THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS MOST PROBABLE ACROSS THE CO FRONT RANGE AND ALONG THE DCVZ...WITH STORMS EXPECTED TO POSE SOME HAIL/WIND RISK AS THEY MOVE EWD AND ENCOUNTER THE RICHER MOISTURE OVER ERN CO. PRIMARILY MULTICELL CLUSTERS ARE EXPECTED...THOUGH SOME MARGINAL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH SOME MODEST INCREASE IN VERTICAL SHEAR THIS EVENING. FARTHER N...STORM DEVELOPMENT IS MORE QUESTIONABLE AND MAY BE CONFINED TO HIGH-BASED CONVECTION ACROSS CENTRAL MT...GIVEN LIMITED LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE AND A PRONOUNCED CAP TO THE E. GUSTY OUTFLOW WINDS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL WILL BE THE MAIN CONCERNS LATE THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING.

sections.title: SRN KS THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: A REMNANT MCV FROM OVERNIGHT CONVECTION WILL DRIFT EWD TODAY OVER SW AND S CENTRAL KS. MEANWHILE...A SURFACE COLD FRONT WILL STALL ACROSS CENTRAL/SRN KS. LOW-MIDLEVEL ASCENT WILL BE FOCUSED ALONG THE BOUNDARY AND IMMEDIATELY IN ADVANCE OF THE REMNANT MCV...WHICH WILL SUPPORT THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL REMAIN WEAK...BUT MODERATE BUOYANCY COULD SUPPORT A FEW DOWNBURSTS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. ..THOMPSON/GLEASON.. 06/23/2016

MEANWHILE...WEST OF THE MOUNTAINS/ACROSS THE OH VALLEY...THE AFOREMENTIONED TRAILING OUTFLOW WILL STALL AND POTENTIALLY RETREAT NORTHWARD TODAY. A FAST-MOVING/DEAMPLIFYING SHORTWAVE TROUGH /CURRENTLY OVER LOWER MI/ WILL CONTRIBUTE TO RENEWED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT AS IT APPROACHES THE LOWER GREAT LAKES LATER TODAY...ESPECIALLY IN VICINITY OF THE REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...BUT POTENTIALLY ALSO NEAR A SURFACE LOW AND THE SYNOPTIC FRONT. SEASONALLY /VERY/ STRONG DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL SUPPORT WELL-ORGANIZED STORMS INCLUDING SUPERCELLS...PARTICULARLY ACROSS WV/EASTERN KY AND FAR SOUTHERN OH. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE

sections.title: CENTRAL/NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: A WEAK MID-LEVEL DISTURBANCE APPEARS TO BE PROGRESSING EASTWARD ACROSS SOUTHERN WY/NORTHERN CO PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY. AS THIS IMPULSE PROGRESSES EASTWARD...ADDITIONAL LEE-SIDE LOW/TROUGH DEVELOPMENT WILL INFLUENCE INCREASINGLY MOIST LOW-LEVEL UPSLOPE FLOW. DIURNAL THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED ALONG THE CO/WY FRONT RANGE...WITH THUNDERSTORMS EXPECTED TO POSE AT LEAST SOME SEVERE HAIL/WIND RISK AS THEY ENCOUNTER SOMEWHAT RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ACROSS EASTERN CO/NEB PANHANDLE. UPWARDS OF 25-35 KT OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL SUPPORT PRIMARILY MULTICELL CLUSTERS ALTHOUGH SOME MARGINAL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES MAY OCCUR WITH A MODEST INCREASE IN VERTICAL SHEAR THIS EVENING. FARTHER NORTH...ISOLATED STORM DEVELOPMENT SHOULD OCCUR ACROSS CENTRAL MT THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING AND MOVE INTO A MODESTLY MOIST/UNSTABLE BOUNDARY LAYER ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL/SOUTHEAST MT. AT LEAST A FEW INSTANCES OF MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND GUSTY OUTFLOW-RELATED WINDS ARE POSSIBLE LATE THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING.

sections.title: SOUTHERN KS THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: A REMNANT MCV FROM OVERNIGHT CONVECTION WILL CONTINUE TO DRIFT SLOWLY EASTWARD THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING OVER SOUTHERN KS...WITH THUNDERSTORM REDEVELOPMENT/INTENSIFICATION EXPECTED TO BE SEMI-FOCUSED AHEAD OF THE MCV AND NEAR A STALLED ROUGHLY WEST/EAST-ORIENTED BOUNDARY ACROSS SOUTH-CENTRAL/SOUTHEAST KS. MODEST VERTICAL SHEAR AND AN INCREASINGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS IN THE PRESENCE OF NEAR 70F SURFACE DEWPOINTS WILL SUPPORT AT LEAST SOME POTENTIAL FOR DOWNBURST WINDS/PULSE-TYPE HAIL. ..GUYER/KERR.. 06/23/2016

sections.text: HAVE MADE ONE MINOR ADJUSTMENT TO 1630Z OUTLOOK BY LOWERING PROBABILITIES OVER PORTIONS OF ERN WV AND WRN VA. EXTENSIVE CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING HAS STABILIZED PORTIONS OF ERN WV AND WRN VA THIS AFTERNOON. WHILE WLY TRAJECTORIES SUGGEST INFLOW LAYER IS FROM MORE BUOYANT REGIONS OF THE LOWER OH VALLEY...IT APPEARS ERN-MOST PORTIONS OF CAT3/ENH RISK CAN BE DOWNGRADED TO SLGT FOR THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. NUMEROUS TSTMS ARE DEVELOPING UPSTREAM ALONG THE OH RIVER VALLEY AND THIS CONVECTION WILL PROPAGATE SEWD IN LINE WITH EARLIER THINKING. ..DARROW.. 06/23/2016 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT THU JUN 23 2016/

sections.title: PORTION OF KY/TN EWD TO THE NC COAST
sections.text: A LOOSELY ORGANIZED W-E BAND OF STORMS FROM SRN KY EWD INTO SRN VA/NRN NC -- WITH EMBEDDED BOWING STRUCTURES -- CONTINUES MOVING SEWD ACROSS THE AREA. ALONG WITH AN AMPLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT S OF THE CONVECTIVE BAND...MODERATE WNWLYS /AROUND 30 KT/ THROUGH THE LOWER AND MID TROPOSPHERE WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT ORGANIZED BANDS OF STORMS CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS.

sections.title: THE HIGH PLAINS REGION
sections.text: CLUSTERS OF STRONG/LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS WILL CONTINUE THIS EVENING ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS...PARTICULARLY ACROSS PORTIONS OF ERN CO/WRN KS AND INTO THE OK/NRN TX PANHANDLE REGION. MODEST MID-LEVEL FLOW IS INDICATED ACROSS MOST OF THIS REGION...BUT WITH LOW-LEVEL SELYS VEERING TO WLY ALOFT...SHEAR SUFFICIENT FOR ORGANIZED STORMS WILL SUPPORT RISK FOR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL...WITHIN THE MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT IN PLACE OVER THIS REGION.

sections.title: THE OZARKS VICINITY
sections.text: A CLUSTER OF STRONG/LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS CONTINUES ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE SRN MO/FAR NRN AR VICINITY...WITHIN A VERY UNSTABLE AIRMASS /MIXED-LAYER CAPE AROUND 4500 J/KG PER THE 00Z SGF RAOB/. WHILE FLOW IS MODEST/WEAK IN THE LOWER TROPOSPHERE...MODERATE WLYS AT MID AND UPPER LEVELS WILL SUPPORT EMBEDDED/ORGANIZED STORMS MOVING EWD ACROSS THE OZARKS...A FEW OF WHICH WILL REMAIN CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ..GOSS.. 06/24/2016

mesoscale_discussions.summary: UPSCALE GROWING/INTENSIFYING THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE ACROSS THE REGION OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...AND MAY EVENTUALLY BE ACCOMPANIED BY AN INCREASING RISK FOR POTENTIALLY DAMAGING SURFACE GUSTS BY 20-22Z. TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR AN INCREASING SEVERE WEATHER THREAT WHICH COULD REQUIRE A WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A GRADUAL INCREASE IN THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY AND INTENSITY IS ONGOING NEAR/EAST OF DODGE CITY INTO AREAS SOUTH THROUGH SOUTHEAST OF GREAT BEND. THIS IS OCCURRING WITHIN A ZONE OF ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL WARM ADVECTION...ASSOCIATED WITH A CONVECTIVELY GENERATED OR ENHANCED IMPULSE MIGRATING AROUND THE NORTHERN PERIPHERY OF MID/UPPER SUBTROPICAL RIDGING. BENEATH MODESTLY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...A SEASONABLY MOIST LOW-LEVEL ENVIRONMENT IS CONTRIBUTING TO SIZABLE CAPE. STORMS MAY STILL BE GENERALLY ROOTED ABOVE THE BOUNDARY LAYER. HOWEVER...THIS IS EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY CHANGE THROUGH 18-21Z...AS INHIBITION FOR BOUNDARY LAYER PARCELS STEADILY WEAKENS WITH INSOLATION. DEEP LAYER MEAN WESTERLY FLOW ACROSS THE REGION IS QUITE WEAK...BUT AN EASTERLY COMPONENT TO THE NEAR SURFACE WINDS IS CONTRIBUTING TO SOME VERTICAL SHEAR TO THE COOL SIDE OF A WEAK FRONTAL ZONE ACROSS SOUTHERN KANSAS. THIS MAY BE ENOUGH TO CONTRIBUTE TO CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION. REGARDLESS...GIVEN THE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT...IT IS POSSIBLE THAT INCREASING CONVECTION MAY GRADUALLY CONTRIBUTE TO THE EVOLUTION OF LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC CYCLONIC CIRCULATION ...STRENGTHENING/CONSOLIDATING SURFACE COLD POOL AND REAR INFLOW. THIS MAY BE ACCOMPANIED BY INCREASING STRONG SURFACE GUSTS...WITH A TENDENCY TO PROPAGATE EASTWARD ACROSS SOUTH CENTRAL INTO SOUTHEASTERN KANSAS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WIND GUSTS ARE POSSIBLE WITH THE CONVECTIVE LINE CURRENTLY MOVING FROM CNTRL WV INTO WRN VA. A WW MAY BE NEEDED IF TRENDS SUGGEST SUFFICIENT COVERAGE OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACED THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM THE EARLY MORNING MCS FROM FVX IN CNTRL VA NWWD TO JUST SW OF CRW IN CNTRL WV AND THEN NNWWD INTO CNTRL OH. WAA INTO THIS BOUNDARY RESULTED IN A PERSISTENT...SOMEWHAT REGENERATIVE CONVECTIVE CLUSTER ACROSS MUCH OF WV FOR THE PAST SEVERAL HOURS. THIS HAS ACTED TO REINFORCE THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WITH DIFFERENTIAL HEATING REINFORCING IT AS WELL. DIURNAL HEATING AND MOSTLY CLEAR SKIES TO THE SOUTH OF THE BOUNDARY HAS RESULTED IN MODERATE DESTABILIZATION...WITH RECENT RADAR IMAGERY SUGGESTING THE CONVECTION OVER WV HAS BEGUN TO FORWARD-PROPAGATE INTO THIS DESTABILIZING AIRMASS. RECENT OBSERVATION AT LWB MEASURED A 42 KT AS NEWLY DEVELOPED CONVECTIVE LINE MOVED THROUGH. THIS REGION IS ON THE EDGE OF STRONGER FLOW ALOFT BUT EFFECTIVE SHEAR IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN AROUND 45 TO 50 KT. THIS VERTICAL SHEAR COMBINED WITH CONTINUED AIRMASS DESTABILIZATION WILL PROVIDE SUPPORT FOR AN ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE SYSTEM CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AS IT MOVES SEWD ACROSS WRN VA AND INTO N-CNTRL NC.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED SOON ACROSS THE REGION WITH THE STORMS CAPABLE OF ALL HAZARDS...INCLUDING A TORNADO OR TWO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT RADAR TRENDS HAVE SHOWN QUICKLY DEVELOPING CONVECTION ACROSS SW OH AND NE KY. CURRENT VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS AN INCREASINGLY AGITATED CU FIELD AHEAD OF THE PRE-FRONTAL TROUGH PUSHING SEWD TOWARD THE OH RIVER. ENVIRONMENT AHEAD OF THIS BOUNDARY IS CHARACTERIZED BY TEMPERATURES IN THE MID 80S...DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW 70S...AND MLCAPE AROUND 1500-2500 J/KG...AND EFFECTIVE SHEAR FROM 40-50 KT. THIS ENVIRONMENT IS SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS AND A WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED TO COVER THE RESULTING SVR THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A LOCALLY ENHANCED DAMAGING WIND THREAT MAY BE REALIZED ACROSS PORTIONS OF SRN WV AND SWRN VA AS THE ONGOING ACTIVITY FORWARD-PROPAGATES INTO THE REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTIVE LINE MOVING INTO SERN WV HAS RECENTLY SHOWN AN INCREASE IN SEWD MOTION...SUGGESTING BETTER STORM ORGANIZATION MAY BE ONGOING. WHILE THE DEGREE OF LINEAR ORGANIZATION IS UNCERTAIN...SOME LOCALLY INCREASED DAMAGING WIND THREAT MAY BE REALIZED WITHIN THIS FORWARD-PROPAGATING REGIME. ADDITIONALLY...RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WAS LOCATED FROM SW WV SEWD INTO CNTRL VA THIS MORNING AND THE CURRENT SUPERCELL IN CRAIG COUNTY IS LIKELY MOVING ALONG THIS BOUNDARY. THIS BOUNDARY..IF STILL PRESENT...MAY PROVIDE ADDITIONAL SUPPORT FOR INCREASED UPDRAFT STRENGTH...WHICH COULD IN TURN SUPPORT MORE STORM ORGANIZATION AND AN INCREASED DAMAGING WIND THREAT. LARGE HAIL AND A TORNADO OR TWO ARE ALSO POSSIBLE...PARTICULARLY WITH ANY STORMS THAT DEVELOP AHEAD OF THE LINE. ..MOSIER.. 06/23/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: RECENT CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT HAS OCCURRED IN EARNEST IN NORTHEAST COLORADO AND SOUTHWESTERN NEBRASKA...WITH MORE SCATTERED DEVELOPMENT SOUTH OF THOSE AREAS. ISOLATED HAIL/WIND ARE THE MAIN THREATS...AND TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR A WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS THUNDERSTORMS HAVE INCREASED IN INTENSITY IN NORTHEASTERN COLORADO AND WESTERN NEBRASKA ALONG A NEARLY STATIONARY N-S ORIENTED SURFACE BOUNDARY IN THAT REGION. MORE SCATTERED CONVECTION HAS INCREASED ACROSS THE COLORADO FRONT RANGE AND ADJACENT AREAS OF NEW MEXICO. THESE STORMS HAVE FORMED IN AN ENVIRONMENT WITH RELATIVELY WEAK DEEP SHEAR OWING TO WEAK FLOW THROUGH 6KM AGL...ALTHOUGH THE OUTFLOW-DOMINANT NATURE OF THESE STORMS...ALONG WITH AREAS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY /2000-3500 J/KG MUCAPE/ IS SUGGESTIVE THAT SOME ORGANIZATION INTO ONE OR TWO FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS/S IS LIKELY THROUGH THE EVENING. THIS MAY OCCUR WITH ONGOING CONVECTION IN SOUTHWESTERN NEBRASKA AND VICINITY...ALTHOUGH HIGH-RESOLUTION MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS MCS DEVELOPMENT FROM SOUTHEASTERN COLORADO EASTWARD ALONG A REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY IN SOUTHWEST KANSAS AND THE OKLAHOMA PANHANDLE. THE BIGGEST THREAT WITH THIS ACTIVITY WILL BE ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS...PERHAPS WITH A SLIGHTLY INCREASED DAMAGING-WIND THREAT NEAR STORMS ORGANIZING ALONG MATURE COLD POOLS THROUGH THE EVENING. AN INCREASING LOW-LEVEL JET THIS EVENING MAY AID IN INCREASING COVERAGE OF STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS...ESPECIALLY AFTER 00Z. HENCE...A WW DOES NOT APPEAR TO BE NEEDED IN THE SHORT TERM...BUT MAY BE REQUIRED AFTER 00Z DEPENDING ON CONVECTIVE COVERAGE/EVOLUTION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A TORNADO THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS MAINLY THE SOUTHERN QUARTER OF WW 289 WITH STORMS DEVELOPING AND/OR EMBEDDED NEAR AND WITHIN THE LEADING BAND OF STORM ACTIVITY ALONG A PRE-FRONTAL WIND SHIFT. A THREAT FOR PRIMARILY DAMAGING WINDS AND A LOWER PROBABILITY FOR A TORNADO CONTINUE ACROSS THE NORTHERN PART OF WW 289 AS STORMS DEVELOP ALONG THE COLD FRONT. THIS SIMILAR THREAT IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE SOUTH OF 289...WITH A NEW SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH TO BE COORDINATED SOON TO INCLUDE PARTS OF SOUTHEAST KY...FAR SOUTHWEST VA...AND EASTERN TN...AND PERHAPS PART OF FAR WESTERN NC.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY EVENING MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED TWO BANDS OF STORMS WITH THE LEADING BAND EXTENDING WESTWARD FROM SOUTHERN WV...AND BISECTING KY FROM EAST TO WEST....WHILE THE SECOND AREA OF STORMS WERE ATTENDANT TO ASCENT WITH THE SOUTHWARD-MOVING COLD FRONT /CURRENTLY IN FAR SOUTHERN OH TO SOUTHERN INDIANA/. GIVEN MODERATE-STRONG INSTABILITY EXTENDING FROM WW 289 INTO TN/NC...STORM MERGERS AND COLD POOL ENHANCEMENT WITH THE LEADING BAND OF STORMS SUGGEST THE THREAT FOR MAINLY DAMAGING WINDS WILL EXPAND SOUTH OF THIS WATCH. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR WITH SOUTHWARD EXTENT WILL REMAIN WEAK...FAVORING COLD-POOL ENHANCED DAMAGING WINDS AS THE PRIMARY THREAT...WITH A DECREASING POTENTIAL FOR ADDITIONAL TORNADOES INTO THE NEW WATCH ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT SHOULD CONTINUE ACROSS REMAINING PORTIONS OF WW 292...AND AS CONVECTION DEVELOPS EASTWARD TOWARD SOUTHWESTERN MISSOURI...A NEW WW ISSUANCE MAY BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LONG-LIVED MCS CONTINUES TO POSE A THREAT FOR SEVERE HAIL/WIND ACROSS PORTIONS OF SOUTHEASTERN KANSAS AND NORTHERN OKLAHOMA ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF A COLD POOL/OUTFLOW IN THE REGION. DEEP SHEAR IS RELATIVELY WEAK WITH THIS ACTIVITY...SUGGESTING THAT INDIVIDUAL CORES THAT DEVELOP ALONG THE LEADING EDGE WILL QUICKLY BECOME UNDERCUT AS THE COLD POOL ADVANCES EASTWARD. IN FACT...MUCH OF THE EASTWARD PROPAGATION OF THIS COLD POOL IS DUE PRIMARILY TO THERMODYNAMIC MECHANISMS. NEVERTHELESS...MODERATE TO STRONG PRE-CONVECTIVE INSTABILITY /EXCEEDING 4000 J/KG MUCAPE IN SOME AREAS/ IS SUSTAINING THESE STORMS AS THEY MOVE SLOWLY EAST. NEWER INITIATION DOWNSTREAM OF THIS COLD POOL WILL POSE AN ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL/WIND THREAT ALSO GIVEN THE STRONG INSTABILITY IN PLACE. OBSERVATIONAL TRENDS AND HIGH-RESOLUTION MODELS SUGGEST THAT THIS COMPLEX WILL CONTINUE EASTWARD INTO SOUTHWESTERN MISSOURI /AND OUT OF WW 292/ BY AROUND 01Z. BETWEEN NOW AND THEN...OBSERVATIONAL TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR A NEW SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH THAT MAY BE NEEDED DOWNSTREAM OF WW 292 AS THE THREAT SHIFTS EASTWARD. ISOLATED SEVERE ACTIVITY MAY ALSO DEVELOP THROUGH DUSK ALONG THE NORTHERN OKLAHOMA PORTION OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...ALTHOUGH THIS THREAT SEEMS A BIT MORE CONDITIONAL DUE TO INCREASED MID-LEVEL INHIBITION WITH SOUTHWARD/WESTWARD EXTENT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: GREATEST SEVERE WEATHER THREAT WILL TEND TO BE WITH THE LEADING W-E ORIENTED BAND OF STORMS MOVING TO THE SOUTHEAST ACROSS THE SOUTHERN HALF OF WW 290. NEW STORMS ARE GRADUALLY DEVELOPING ALONG THE WESTERN FLANK OF THIS BAND INTO WESTERN KY. ADDITIONAL STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE ACROSS FAR SOUTHERN INDIANA TO ADJACENT KY /IN THE NORTHERN HALF OF WW 290/ AS STORMS FORM ALONG THE SOUTHWARD-MOVING COLD FRONT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE ENVIRONMENT ACROSS WW 290 REMAINS VERY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE OF 2500-3500 J/KG BOTH ALONG AND SOUTH OF THE LEADING BAND OF STORMS MOVING TO THE SOUTHEAST ACROSS CENTRAL/SOUTHERN KY AND ACROSS SOUTHERN INDIANA AND ADJACENT KY COUNTIES. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR REMAINS THE GREATEST ACROSS ACROSS SOUTHERN INDIANA INTO NORTHERN KY...SUGGESTING STORMS THAT FORM ALONG THE COLD FRONT AS IT MOVES SOUTHWARD THROUGH THE VERY STRONG INSTABILITY WILL HAVE A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND/OR HAIL. MEANWHILE...THE BAND OF STORMS MOVING INTO SOUTHERN KY AND NEW DEVELOPMENT ALONG ITS WESTERN FLANK WILL HAVE A SEVERE RISK FOR MAINLY DAMAGING WINDS AS THIS ACTIVITY WILL MOVE INTO WEAKER DEEP-LAYER SHEAR AND BE ENHANCED BY STORM MERGERS/COLD POOL FORMATION. ..PETERS.. 06/23/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL WILL REMAIN THE PRIMARY THREATS WITH STORMS ACROSS THE VALID PORTION OF WW 291 THIS EVENING. AND...A TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT. LOCAL WFO EXPANSION OF WW 291 IS LIKELY ACROSS ITS SOUTHERN EXTENT...WHILE COUNTIES IN THE FAR NORTHERN EXTENT OF THIS WATCH COULD BE CANCELLED EARLY AS THE AIR MASS IS CONVECTIVELY OVERTURNED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WEAK HEIGHT FALLS ARE EXPECTED ACROSS WW 291 WITHIN THE SOUTHERN INFLUENCE OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH TRACKING ACROSS AND IN LEE OF THE LOWER GREAT LAKES REGION THIS EVENING. THIS ATTENDANT FORCING FOR ASCENT...A BAND OF 50+ KT NORTHWESTERLY 500-MB WINDS...AND RESIDUAL MODERATE INSTABILITY FROM SOUTHERN VA INTO NC WILL SUPPORT ADDITIONAL STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS. DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. HOWEVER...ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL SHEAR IN VICINITY OF LEFTOVER CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES FROM CENTRAL AND WESTERN NC INTO SOUTHWEST VA WILL POSE SOME POTENTIAL FOR A TORNADO THREAT. ..PETERS.. 06/24/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS CENTRAL AND EASTERN PORTIONS OF WW 294...AND HAS EXITED WW 292.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS CONTINUES TO MOVE SLOWLY EASTWARD ACROSS WW 294 ATTM. THESE STORMS ARE PRIMARILY OUTFLOW-DOMINANT...AND CAPABLE OF A FEW DAMAGING WIND GUSTS ESPECIALLY NEAR THE STRONGER THUNDERSTORM CORES. A SLOW EASTWARD PROPAGATION SHOULD CONTINUE WITH THIS ACTIVITY OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...WITH SOME DECREASE IN INTENSITY LIKELY AS NOCTURNAL BOUNDARY LAYER COOLING...AND AN ATTENDANT DECREASE IN SURFACE-BASED INSTABILITY...CONTINUES. IT ALSO APPEARS THAT SUFFICIENT CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING HAS OCCURRED ACROSS WW 292...AND WESTERN PORTIONS OF WW 294...RESULTING IN A DECREASED SEVERE THREAT THERE. AS A RESULT...WWS 292 AND WESTERN PORTIONS OF 294 MAY BE CANCELLED BEFORE THEIR PREVIOUSLY SCHEDULED EXPIRATION TIMES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS WW 295.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COUPLE OF BROKEN LINEAR SEGMENTS CONTINUE ACROSS WW 295 AT THIS TIME...ONE ACROSS FAR NORTHEASTERN COLORADO AND THE OTHER IN SOUTHEASTERN COLORADO NEAR LAA. THESE SEGMENTS CONTINUE TO BE CAPABLE OF DAMAGING DOWNBURSTS APPROACHING SEVERE LIMITS AS THEY CONTINUE TO PROPAGATE SLOWLY EASTWARD IN A WEAKLY SHEARED...YET MODERATELY UNSTABLE PRE-CONVECTIVE ENVIRONMENT. OBSERVATIONS AND MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS THAT STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO PROPAGATE EASTWARD THROUGHOUT THE DURATION OF WW 295...WITH THE GREATEST LONGEVITY OF STORMS EXPECTED IN SOUTHWESTERN KANSAS. HERE...A GREATER SPATIAL EXTENT OF MODERATE INSTABILITY EXISTS ALONG WITH A 30-KT SOUTHEASTERLY LOW-LEVEL JET...WHICH WILL HELP WITH STORM/MCS MAINTENANCE IN THESE AREAS. DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND ISOLATED INSTANCES OF HAIL WILL CONTINUE TO BE THE MOST LIKELY THREATS WITH THIS ACTIVITY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR SEVERE STORMS CONTINUES ACROSS WW 290...ATTENDANT TO TWO WEST-EAST ORIENTED BANDS OF STORMS MOVING TO THE SOUTH...WHILE THE RECENT INCREASE IN STORMS THAT MOVED INTO NORTHWEST KY SUGGESTS WW 290 COULD BE EXTENDED IN TIME BEYOND 03Z. AS STORMS IN SOUTHERN KY AND NORTHEAST TN PROGRESS SOUTHWARD...ADDITIONAL COUNTIES WITHIN PARTS OF MIDDLE AND EASTERN TN COULD BE ADDED TO WW 293. HOWEVER...DETAILS IN THE DISCUSSION SUGGEST THIS POTENTIAL IS LOW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0225Z...MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY INDICATED A FEW GENERALLY WEST-EAST ORIENTED BANDS OF STORMS ADVANCING TO THE SOUTH/SOUTHEAST ACROSS WESTERN AND SOUTHERN KY...SOUTHWEST VA AND NORTHEAST TN. THE DOWNSTREAM ENVIRONMENT CONTINUES TO STABILIZE...GIVEN THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING...WITH THE STRONGEST INSTABILITY RESIDING FROM WESTERN KY THROUGH MUCH OF TN. STORMS IN SOUTHWEST VA/NORTHEAST TN ARE TRACKING TO THE SOUTHEAST AT AROUND 35 KT AND THE STORMS IN SOUTHERN KY MOVING INTO NORTHERN MIDDLE TN ARE TRACKING TO THE SOUTH NEAR 35 KT...WITH THESE SPEEDS SUFFICIENT FOR SOME STRONGER WIND GUSTS AT THE SURFACE. HOWEVER...THE ONGOING BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZATION APPEARS TO BE LIMITING THE DAMAGING WIND THREAT...AS OBSERVED WIND GUSTS FROM SOUTHERN KY TO SOUTHWEST VA HAVE REMAINED SUB-SEVERE RECENTLY. THEREFORE...A FEW NEW COUNTIES COULD BE ADDED TO WW 293...BUT THIS POTENTIAL IS EXPECTED TO BE RELATIVELY LIMITED. FARTHER NORTH...A FEW STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS NORTHWEST INTO WEST-CENTRAL KY ACROSS THE VALID NORTHERN PORTION OF WW 290...AS MRMS MESH DATA HAS INDICATED A COUPLE OF STORMS WITH HAIL AROUND 1 INCH IN DIAMETER. INSTABILITY REMAINS MODERATELY STRONG AND THIS REGION RESIDES ALONG THE SOUTHERN EXTENT OF STRONGER DEEP-LAYER SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED STORMS. ..PETERS.. 06/24/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL/WIND THREAT EXISTS IN SOUTHERN PORTIONS OF WW 295...WHILE THE THREAT IN THE REMAINDER OF THE WATCH HAS BEEN REDUCED TO NEAR NIL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: PORTIONS OF WW 295 CONTINUE ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA. A FORWARD-PROPAGATING LINEAR SEGMENT ENTERED WESTERN KANSAS OVER THE PAST HOUR OR SO...AND HAS A HISTORY OF AT LEAST A COUPLE OF INSTANCES OF STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS. THIS LINEAR SYSTEM IS MOVING ALONG AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY /AROUND 2000 J/KG MUCAPE/ BASED MOSTLY IN THE MID-LEVELS. DEEP SHEAR IS NOT ALL THAT IMPRESSIVE...ALTHOUGH MODEST STRENGTHENING OF LOW-LEVEL WIND FIELDS IN THIS REGION /TO AROUND 20 KNOTS/ IS SUPPORTING CONTINUED ORGANIZATION OF THIS LINEAR SEGMENT. THIS SEGMENT SHOULD REACH THE EASTERN PORTIONS OF WW 295 WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR...AND REACH THE DDC AREA AROUND 0530Z...WITH ISOLATED SEVERE WIND/WIND DAMAGE REMAINING POSSIBLE. LOCAL EXTENSIONS OF WW 295 MAY BE NEEDED TO ADDRESS THIS THREAT. SOUTHWEST OF THIS LINEAR SEGMENT...ADDITIONAL CONVECTION CONTINUES ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE WESTERN OKLAHOMA PANHANDLE THAT MAY ALSO POSE AN ISOLATED DAMAGING-WIND THREAT THROUGHOUT THE DURATION OF WW 295. ELSEWHERE...CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING AND WEAKENING SURFACE-BASED INSTABILITY HAS EFFECTIVELY ENDED THE SEVERE THREAT FROM NEAR I-70 NORTHWARD. THESE AREAS OF WW 295 MAY BE CANCELLED EARLY.
